correctness.rationale: The transport u star v = alpha(uv) is verified directly on basis elements. The augmentation ideal of K[(F_p)^r] is nilpotent; this excludes every nonzero augmentation-zero idempotent. Every 1+I element has pth power 1, so augmentation-one idempotents are precisely the 2^(-1) eigenspace of alpha on the elementary abelian p-group 1+I. The alpha-equivariant filtration (1+I^j)/(1+I^(j+1)) identifies with I^j/I^(j+1); since ord_p(2) divides p-1, Maschke splitting gives representation equivalence between 1+I and I. Nonzero G consists of (p^r-1)/ord_p(2) regular doubling cycles, each with a one-dimensional eigenline over K. This proves the exact q-power and the midpoint law. Direct enumeration over F3,F5,F7,F9 corroborates the formula and quandle closure; it is not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Idempotents of quandle algebras are a natural structural invariant connected to quandle-coloring enhancements and questions about coefficient dependence. The complete structural classification shows an exponentially enlarged midpoint quandle: for p=3,r=2, 81 nonzero idempotents versus 9 basis elements; for p=7,r=1, 49 versus 7. The eigenvalue-orbit formula explains the arithmetic role of ord_p(2), and treats all ranks and coefficient extension degrees rather than an arbitrary parameter slice. It is a complete motivated classification, not just a small computational example.
